news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 发布 llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1。LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 时，未直接依赖 httpx 的插件会受影响，该插件是其中之一，现已修复。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 修复了 LLM 插件兼容性问题，确保使用 httpx 的插件在 LLM 0.33 后继续工作。
news.summary_en: Release of llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1. The switch to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 broke plugins that used httpx without directly depending on it; this plugin was one of them and is now fixed.
news.why_it_matters_en: It fixes a plugin compatibility issue so LLM plugins that rely on httpx keep working after LLM 0.33.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: 发布 llm-echo 0.5。作者在准备新版 LLM 并测试 PR 时重新审视了这个调试插件；它提供一个不涉及 LLM 的“模型”，只回显输入的提示。新版本更新了模拟 token 用量统计，以计入工具调用、系统提示等因素。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 帮助开发者在无真实模型调用的情况下调试 LLM 插件和 token 统计。
news.summary_en: Release of llm-echo 0.5. While preparing a new LLM release and testing PRs, the author revisited this debug plugin, which provides a “model” that does not involve an LLM and simply echoes prompts. The release updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts, and other factors.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps developers debug LLM plugins and token accounting without making real model calls.

news.summary: Release: web-edit 0.1a2 web-edit ( previously ) is my tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder. I mainly built it for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it

top5.what_zh: Anthropic 表示将把 5% 的股份投入一个公共福利基金。
top5.what_en: Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund.
top5.why_zh: 这是 AI 实验室中较罕见的股权与治理安排，可能影响其公共责任和长期治理结构。
top5.why_en: This is an unusual equity and governance arrangement for an AI lab and could affect its public accountability and long-term governance.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 信号意义强，但摘要信息有限，基金的控制权、用途和治理机制尚不清楚。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Strong signal value, but the summary is limited; the fund’s control, use, and governance mechanisms remain unclear.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会是使命与股权绑定；风险是治理细节不透明，实际约束力待观察。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity is aligning mission with equity; risk is opaque governance details and unclear real-world constraints.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并核实基金结构、控制权和披露安排。
top5.action_en: Read the source and verify the fund structure, control, and disclosure arrangements.

top5.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告“失控 AI 代理”活动的国家
top5.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: 印度成为最新报告失控 AI 代理活动的国家；这些代理通过应用配置、公开代码仓库中暴露的凭据和连接设置，以及权限过宽的云角色进入。
top5.what_en: India became the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity; the agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 问题指向代理安全的基本面：凭据泄露和云权限过宽，对构建者尤其有警示意义。
top5.why_en: The issue points to agent security fundamentals: leaked credentials and overly broad cloud permissions, which is especially relevant to builders.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这是具体、可操作的代理安全警示，但应避免把所有代理事故泛化为模型失控。
top5.editor_judgment_en: This is a concrete, actionable agent-security warning, but it should not be generalized into all agent incidents being model runaway.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会是安全审计与最小权限实践；风险是凭据泄露和公开仓库暴露导致入侵。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity is security auditing and least-privilege practice; risk is intrusion via leaked credentials and public-repo exposure.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文，并检查暴露的凭据、公开仓库和权限过宽的云角色。
top5.action_en: Read the source and check for exposed credentials, public repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

editorial.core_zh: 本期主线是 AI 能力与治理同时推进：多模态推理、受监管行业落地、人才与资本重组，以及代理安全风险。
editorial.core_en: This cycle’s thread is capability and governance advancing together: multimodal reasoning, regulated-industry deployment, talent and capital reshuffling, and agent security risk.
editorial.trend_zh: AI 竞争正从模型参数转向可验证的应用、治理结构和安全底线。
editorial.trend_en: AI competition is shifting from model specs toward verifiable applications, governance structures, and security fundamentals.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当厂商自评成为主要证据时，用户和开发者应如何独立验证多模态模型与代理部署的真实能力与风险？
editorial.next_question_en: As vendor evaluations become the main evidence, how should users and developers independently verify the real capabilities and risks of multimodal models and agent deployments?
